request: Owner, with a screenshot of the cabinet hero where the rider was a small figure far down the road: «Ладно, просто убери видео, просто сделай динамичную, классную картинку, где он просто едет, всё, больше ничего не надо».
decision: No animation in the cabinet hero any more: no video, no canvas, no moving cut-out. One still picture in which Vespi rides; the motion is in the picture itself.

first_round.references: The site's own depth plate (job 3781b572-6756-4e3f-8ff9-357258b4bafc), the approved riders (d3d2cbba-8a30-43fd-ac47-55423c35b1ba, f37e14e5-46c3-427e-8094-2165022384a6) and two approved Vespi identity pictures. No owner photographs.
first_round.finding: In all three the rider took 34–41% of the frame height; under the cabinet's panel a tablet shows only the lower 32%.

chosen.from: ca724e48-3bf4-4c9f-aa45-edd811b37d51, the same picture asked again from farther away and a little higher
chosen.not_used: 022f1dfe-fc4a-49e7-a77b-483438b661bb (the side panning shot zoomed out: the strongest speed blur, but a side view again, the one the owner called flat)
chosen.brief: A toy scooter riding toward the camera down the Amalfi coast road at golden hour: the two-lane road recedes behind him to a vanishing point low in the frame; parapet with bougainvillea and the sea with the low sun on one side, a stone wall with lemon terraces and the village with the majolica dome on the other; the rider small, in the bottom quarter, tack-sharp, scarf streaming, headlight on, petals in the air; the asphalt and the roadside streaked toward the vanishing point. Face in full: two open dot eyes and a small smile.

upscale_tried.verdict: Not used: the upscaler smoothed the plush and felt into plastic and redrew the helmet badge. The 2336 × 1744 original is shipped.

edit: Mirrored: in the generated picture he came toward us on the left side of his road; mirrored he keeps to the right, as traffic in Italy does. Nothing in the picture has letters or a hand; the village is now on the left and the sea with the sun on the right.

layout.desktop: The stage is 1.15 of the tile and centred: the village, the road with Vespi and the sun over the sea all stand around the panel.
layout.tablet: The upper two thirds are under the panel, so the stage is 1.4 of the tile with the picture's 41% at the centre: Vespi is about 131 px tall on an 820 px iPad and sits whole in the band under the panel (his helmet starts at 70% of the tile, the panel ends at 68%; the band is at least 160–220 px by the tile's own padding).
layout.phone: A closer 4:3 frame of the same picture (4–68% of its width, 33.5–97.5% of its height: the village, the road and Vespi), shown whole above the sheet; its own file, so a phone loads 98–185 KB instead of 305–399 KB.

face_rule: Two small open round black dot eyes and a small smile, pink cheeks — checked on the shipped picture at full size.
